sub_sector.value: regional Portland and masonry cement; ready-mixed concrete

manufacturing_type.detail: Continuous kiln-based cement production from limestone and raw materials.

production_model.detail: Bulk cement produced continuously and stored in silos for regional customers.

product_complexity.detail: Standardized Portland, masonry and Portland-limestone cements sold on consistency and quality.

production_role.detail: Produces cement as the basic component of concrete, mortar and masonry; also vertically integrated into ready-mix.

end_market_exposure.detail: Concrete, mortar and masonry for buildings, roads and infrastructure across the Midwest; also ready-mixed concrete and block.

notes: ">Process, production model and role partly inferred from product type and general knowledge of cement; ready-mix and block subsidiaries known but not in evidence."
